title: Diane Powell meets Akil after his mother saw her interviewed by Deepak Chopra

tellings.quote: contacting me after seeing me um being interviewed by deepo tro

plain: Diane Powell, who studies children said to be able to read minds, says she came to know a boy named Akil in New Jersey in 2022 because his mother, Manisha, saw Powell interviewed by the wellness author Deepak Chopra and got in touch. Powell tells this herself on the show, as how she came to work with Akil.
